name: analyze-codebase-workflow
description: Analyze an arbitrary codebase to auto-detect workflows, data pipelines, and file dependencies using putior's put_auto() engine. Produces an annotation plan that maps detected I/O patterns to source files across 30+ supported languages with 902 auto-detection patterns. Use when onboarding onto an unfamiliar codebase to understand data flow, starting putior integration in a project without existing annotations, auditing a project's data pipeline before documentation, or preparing an annotation plan before running annotate-source-files.

findings.excerpt: find /path/to/repo -type f | sed 's/.*\.//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20
